item.title: The Maynard Communities of Practice Initiative takes flight
item.description: Building community is central to the Maynard Institute’s mission. In April we launched our Maynard Communities of Practice, a tuition-free initiative for all institute alumni. item.title: Meet Nadia Campbell-Mitchell, our new Director of Development! Plus more changing staff roles.
item.description: The Maynard Institute is proud to announce the hiring of Nadia Campbell-Mitchell as our new Director of Development. As Director of Development, Nadia will be a strategic partner to Co-Executive Directors Evelyn Hsu and Martin G. Reynolds. The post Meet Nadia Campbell-Mitchell, our new Director of Development! item.description: The Maynard Institute’s Regional Training Series will welcome another dynamic cohort of emerging media leaders on July 17 and 18, hosted by UNC Chapel Hill’s Hussman School of Journalism and Media and the Center for Innovation and Sustainability in Local Media (CISLM).
